name: MC12
description: The Maserati MC12 (2004–2005) was a homologation special for GT racing built on the Ferrari Enzo platform. Just 50 road cars were produced alongside the racing versions, making it one of the rarest Maseratis ever. With a 6.0-litre Ferrari V12 producing 630 hp, it was also the fastest Maserati road car until the MC20.
